concept_name: Suteki Japanese Restaurant (Sushi Bar, Hot Kitchen & Commissary)

Module 1: Personal Hygiene, Health Clear.Description: Employees perform full 20-second hand scrub with antibacterial soap and potable water at mandatory task transitions, cash handling, and break returns.
ABSOLUTELY ZERO bare-hand contact with Ready-to-Eat (RTE) foods (acidified sushi rice, sashimi, nigiri, maki fillings, salad greens, cooked chasu); clean gloves or sanitized tongs used.
Dedicated handwashing sinks in kitchen and sushi bar are completely unobstructed, fully functional, and accessible at all times.
Hand sinks are continuously stocked with liquid antibacterial soap, single-use paper towels, 70% alcohol dispenser, and a covered foot-pedal waste bin.
Documented Employee Health Policy active; staff can explain reportable communicable symptoms (diarrhea, vomiting, jaundice, fever with sore throat) and 48-hr exclusion.
Mandatory 48-hour symptom-free illness exclusion enforced; valid local Health Certificate ID cards (EHS-102) compiled on-site for 100% of staff.
Cuts, wounds, or lesions on hands/wrists covered with waterproof blue detectable bandages PLUS a clean food-grade disposable glove.
Staff wear clean company uniforms and non-slip closed-toe shoes; aprons removed completely before entering restrooms or stepping outside.
Clean hairnets or headwear enclosing hair completely worn by sushi chefs and kitchen crew; front-of-house staff maintain securely tied-back hair.
Fingernails trimmed short, clean, and free of polish, artificial extensions, or acrylic overlays across all food and beverage handlers.
Zero-jewelry policy enforced on lines (plain smooth wedding band only; no watches, bracelets, stone rings, or exposed body piercings).
Personal belongings, cellphones, drinks, and street clothing stored in designated lockers away from prep counters, sushi bar, and warewashing sinks.
Eating, drinking from open cups, or vaping/tobacco strictly prohibited in food/beverage prep, dishwashing, and service staging zones.
High-visibility bilingual/pictorial handwashing procedure and glove-changing signage posted directly at all hand sinks and restrooms.
Food safety training records (LOG-TR-01) on-site; staff verified competent in cross-contamination, Big 9 allergen controls, and sanitation SSOPs.

Module 2: Sushi Bar, Shari Acidification.Description: HACCP CCP 2: Every batch of cooked sushi rice blended with seasoned vinegar to achieve verified pH <= 4.40 (Target: 4.10–4.30); logged on Form LOG-SUS-01 before release.
4-Hour TPHC Holding: Acidified Shari held at ambient room temperature (32°C–37°C) under Time as a Public Health Control for maximum 4 hours with waterproof discard timestamp tags.
Makisu bamboo rolling mats tightly wrapped with 3 layers of food-grade plastic cling film; zero exposed bamboo wood during rolling.
Makisu cling-film barrier completely stripped, discarded, and replaced with fresh film at least every 2 hours or immediately if torn/soiled; logged on LOG-SUS-02.
Raw sashimi and nigiri saku blocks retrieved in micro-batches from Right Chiller Tier 2 (<= 3.3°C) and staged inside nested double-pan crushed ice beds on the bench.
Strict 20-minute maximum ambient bench dwell limit enforced for raw fish staging; product surface temp maintained <= 4.0°C (39.2°F); logged on LOG-SUS-03.
Dual cutting board segregation at sushi station: BLUE board strictly for raw fish trimming/portioning; WHITE board strictly for RTE Maki/Nigiri assembly and plating.
Yanagiba sashimi knife blades wiped clean and sanitized with 70% alcohol wipes between switching fish species (Salmon to Tuna) and prior to RTE plating.
Acidic Tezu bowl (potable water + vinegar/mirin) prepared fresh and refreshed every 2 hours for gloved fingertip conditioning during nigiri pressing.
Commercial bagged edible ice received from accredited suppliers with intact seals, batch codes, and clean delivery bags (PRP-WAT-01).
Ice scoop constructed of food-grade stainless steel/polycarbonate, stored in dedicated clean external holster; zero scoops left inside ice chest.
Monthly accredited laboratory Microbiological Potability Water Analysis Report (PNSDW compliance) current and filed on-site.
Blender pitchers (frappes/smoothies) rinsed after every drink, sanitized between allergen transitions, and disassembled into 4 parts nightly.
Sushi bar rails, ingredient pans, and expediting pass cleaned and sanitized every shift; completely free of sticky residues and pests.
Sushi chefs can state exact critical limits for shari pH (<= 4.40), raw fish bench dwell (<= 20m), and makisu replacement intervals (2 hrs).

Module 3: Cold Chain, Right Chiller Stor.Description: 4-Door combination unit maintains internal product temperatures: Right Chiller <= 39.2°F (4.0°C) [ambient <= 3.3°C] and Left Freezer <= 0°F (-18.0°C).
4-Tier Vertical Storage Hierarchy strictly maintained in Right Chiller: Tier 1 (Cooked/RTE/Sauces/Produce) -> Tier 2 (Fish Saku) -> Tier 3 (Pork/Beef) -> Tier 4 (Raw Chicken).
100% of decanted, prepped, and transferred containers display indelible 5-field waterproof secondary date labels (< 72h meats / < 48h produce / < 7d sauces).
TCS Cold Specialty Sauces (Japanese Mayo, Spicy Mayo, Wasabi Mayo, Unagi Tare) stored continuously in Right Chiller Tier 1 (<= 4.0°C) with strict 7-day discard limit.
ABSOLUTELY ZERO TOP-FILLING of sauce squeeze bottles; empty bottles removed, washed, sanitized, and dried before refilling with fresh sauce.
Working sauce squeeze bottles on prep counters returned to Right Chiller immediately after service rushes; cumulative ambient exposure limited to < 2 hours.
Conspicuous, accurate digital ambient thermometers installed in all chiller and freezer compartments; checked for zero battery drift.
Internal temperatures of refrigerated TCS foods (raw fish, pork, chicken, sauces, broth) logged at 4-hour intervals (08:00, 12:00, 16:00, 20:00) in LOG-TEMP-01.
Commercial freezer maintains foods rock-solid; ambient air maintained at <= 0°F (-18°C) with no excessive frost or defrost breakdown.
Chiller shelves non-corrosive, clean, and not overloaded, maintaining a minimum 2-inch clearance for 360-degree cold air circulation.
Magnetic rubber door gaskets on all 4 doors are clean, flexible, seal airtight, and 100% free of black mold biofilms.
Dispensing nozzle tips and screw caps wiped clean with 70% alcohol wipes every 2 hours and fitted with protective caps when not dispensing.
Sauce squeeze bottles disassembled into 3 parts (body, cap, nozzle), soaked in chemical sanitizer, and air-dried inverted daily.
Zero spoiled, sour, discolored, or expired items present in inventory; expired items quarantined immediately in waste bin.
Daily cold chain temperature tracking logs reviewed, verified, and signed off daily by the Shift Supervisor or FSCO.

Module 4: Commissary Intake, Controlled.Description: HACCP CCP 1 (Commissary Intake): Delivery batches from owner SUV inspected immediately; temperature verified (Chilled <= 4.0°C / Frozen <= -18.0°C) & logged on LOG-REC-01.
ABSOLUTELY ZERO raw meat, poultry, or seafood observed thawing at ambient room temperature, on cook lines, on floors, or in standing warm water sinks.
Controlled Cold-Chain Thawing: Frozen proteins thawed inside Right Chiller (Tier 2/3/4) at <= 3.3°C ambient / <= 4.0°C core inside covered drip pans (SOP-THW-01).
Emergency running water thawing conducted in sanitized prep sink with cold running water (<= 21°C) for < 2 hours; product core maintained <= 4.0°C.
Commissary Transfer Slips (CTS) verified for batch numbers, preparation timestamps, and allergen declarations prior to acceptance (PRP-TRACE-01).
Raw chicken, pork, and beef prepped in a dedicated prep zone strictly physically separated from RTE sushi and cooked finishing stations.
Raw protein prep tables and cutting boards washed, rinsed, and sanitized immediately following raw meat manipulation.
Disposable gloves removed and discarded immediately after touching raw poultry/meat; hands washed for 20 seconds before touching other surfaces.
Raw meat marinade containers are food-grade, sealed with airtight lids, and dated with prep and discard timestamps.
Corrugated packaging and outer commissary plastic bags disposed of directly into lined waste bins; zero contact with clean food contact surfaces.

Module 5: Thermal Lethality, Deep-Frying.Description: HACCP CCP 3 (Poultry Lethality): Chicken Karaage deep-fried to internal core temp >= 165°F (74.0°C) held for >= 15 seconds; logged on LOG-HOT-01.
HACCP CCP 3 (Pork Lethality): Pork Tonkatsu loin cutlets deep-fried to internal core temp >= 158°F (70.0°C) held for >= 15 seconds; logged on LOG-HOT-01.
HACCP CCP 3 (Seafood Tempura): Ebi Tempura and Calamari deep-fried to internal core temp >= 145°F (63.0°C) held for >= 15 seconds; logged on LOG-HOT-01.
HACCP CCP 4 (Ramen Broth Reheating): Commissary ramen broths rapidly reheated on direct flame/induction to rolling boil >= 165°F (74.0°C) within 2 hrs; logged on LOG-HOT-02.
HOT HOLDING: Reheated ramen broths maintained in pre-heated soup warmers at >= 140°F (60.0°C) [target 65°C–80°C]; checked every 2 hours.
4-Hour Broth Holding Limit: Broth holding limited to maximum 4 hours with discard timestamp tags; zero top-filling of new broth into old warmer residue.
Sanitary Two-Spoon sensory tasting method strictly enforced for ramen broth and sauce seasoning; ZERO direct pot-to-mouth tasting.
Sizzling cast-iron platters preheated on high flame to >= 392°F (200.0°C) verified via infrared thermometer before assembling rice and beef/salmon.
Sizzling beef slices flash-sear against iron surface to achieve secondary thermal lethality (>= 70.0°C) during sauce sizzle and customer table mixing.
Branded 3-inch anti-splatter disposable paper collar securely fitted around wooden underliner; server verbally cautions guest upon table delivery.
Hot Appetizer Pan-Frying: Gyoza dumplings (sear-and-steam) and Takoyaki octopus balls probed to core temp >= 165°F (74.0°C) for 15s; logged on LOG-HOT-04.
Deep fryer oil quality monitored 2x daily; oil discarded immediately when Total Polar Materials (TPM) exceed 24.0% or oil smokes below 170°C.
Digital stem probe thermometers calibrated weekly (Mondays 09:00 AM) in 50/50 ice slurry (32°F / 0°C ± 1°F); logged on LOG-HOT-05 (LOG-CAL-01).
Fryer baskets, skimmers, and tongs in good repair (no broken wire mesh, rust, or loose metal fragments posing physical hazards).
Kitchen line cooks can state the exact minimum internal cooking temperature for poultry (74°C), pork (70°C), broth reheat (74°C), and sizzling iron (200°C).

Module 6: Cross-Contamination & Big 9 Al.Description: Vertical refrigeration storage hierarchy followed: Top: RTE/Sushi/Produce -> 2nd: Fish Saku -> 3rd: Pork/Beef -> Bottom: Raw Chicken (SOP-STO-01).
Color-coded cutting board system strictly enforced: WHITE: RTE/Maki/Cooked Meats | BLUE: Raw Fish | YELLOW: Raw Poultry | RED: Raw Pork/Beef | PURPLE: Allergens.
BIG 9 ALLERGEN SEGREGATION: Crustacean (Ebi), Fish, Soy, Sesame, Wheat/Gluten, Egg, Dairy, Peanut, Tree Nuts managed with distinct dedicated utensils.
Dedicated allergen prep tools (PURPLE board, knife, tongs) utilized exclusively for allergen-free customer tickets (PRP-ALLERG-01).
Sushi chefs and kitchen handlers wash hands and change gloves immediately when switching between allergen orders and allergen-free orders.
Prominent Allergen Advisory Disclaimer displayed on customer menus and cashier counter signage informing guests of major allergens.
Dual-tong segregation strictly maintained: Dedicated Yellow/Red tongs for raw meats; sanitized stainless steel tongs for cooked food extraction.
Food, sushi rice sacks, and dry ingredients stored a minimum of 6 inches (15 cm) above the finished floor on clean stainless/wire shelving.
Dry ingredients (tempura flour, panko, nori sheets, seasonings) stored in food-grade sealed bins labeled with product name and secondary expiry.
FIFO / FEFO inventory rotation evident across all dry storage, reach-in coolers, and kitchen prep staging lines.
Supplier expiration dates, manufacturing codes, and secondary prep date labels never overwritten, obscured, or falsified.
Wiping cloths color-coded and stored submerged in chemical sanitizing solution buckets (200 PPM Quat) when not in active use; cloths refreshed every 2 hours.
Fresh produce washed exclusively in dedicated prep basin with 50–100 PPM Chlorine for 60s, rinsed with potable water, and spin-dried (SSOP-CLN-03).
Garnishes (cucumber matchsticks, mango batons, chopped scallions) prepped with dedicated sanitized knives and cutting boards (SSOP-CLN-03).
Customer takeaway packaging (maki boxes, ramen bowls, cups, chopsticks) stored inverted in clean dispensers away from splash zones (SOP-FOH-03).

Module 7: 2-Compartment Sink SSOP, Floor.Description: 2-COMPARTMENT SINK PROTOCOL: Basin 1 (Wash with alkaline detergent at >= 45.0°C) -> Basin 2 (Clean potable rinse) -> Dedicated Auxiliary Sanitizer Immersion Tub (SSOP-CLN-01).
STRUCTURAL COMPENSATION: Pre-wash scraping and rubber spatula debris clearing executed before Sink 1 to prevent organic loading of wash water.
Chemical sanitizer bath (50–100 PPM Chlorine or 200 PPM Quat) maintained in dedicated auxiliary tub with MINIMUM 60-SECOND full submersion contact dwell time.
Chemical test strips available on-site and utilized every 2 hours to verify sanitizer concentration in the active sanitizing bath; logged on Form LOG-CLN-01.
All washed, rinsed, and sanitized dishware, ramen bowls, and smallwares air-dried inverted on clean wire racks; ABSOLUTELY ZERO TOWEL-DRYING.
Cutting boards smooth, non-porous, free of deep scoring (> 1.0 mm) or dark mold stains, and stored VERTICALLY in slotted stainless racks (SSOP-CLN-02).
Chemicals, degreasers, descalers, and sanitizers stored in a dedicated locked chemical cabinet strictly segregated from food/packaging zones (PRP-SAN-01).
All secondary chemical spray bottles clearly labeled with chemical name, concentration, and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) hazard pictograms (PRP-SAN-01).
Exhaust canopy hood filters, grease drip cups, and ventilation fans clean, degreased weekly, and free of dripping grease hazards (SSOP-CLN-04).
High-touch surfaces (door handles, POS touchscreens, chiller door handles) sanitized with 200 PPM Quat disinfectant every 2 to 4 hours (SSOP-CLN-04, SOP-FOH-03).
Nightly kitchen floor 4-step cleaning: Dry sweep -> Hot water (>= 50°C) + alkaline degreaser (1:20) 5-min dwell -> Stiff deck scrub -> Squeegee/mop dry (SSOP-CLN-05).
Zero Standing Water Pool mandate strictly enforced; floors squeegeed toward standard floor drains and mopped completely dry within 15 minutes (SSOP-CLN-05).
Under-sink grease traps inspected, skimmed weekly, sealed airtight, and waste grease disposed of in sealed bags per SM Mall EHS guidelines (SSOP-CLN-04).
Floor drain strainers cleared of solid debris nightly and drain traps sanitized by pouring 2 Liters of 200 PPM Quat solution (SSOP-CLN-05).
Master Cleaning Schedule (Form LOG-CLN-04) visibly posted, assigning specific deep-cleaning duties, frequencies, chemicals, and sign-offs (SSOP-CLN-04).

Module 8: Integrated Pest Management (IP.Description: Zero evidence of active rodent activity (droppings, gnaw marks, rub marks, urine stains) across dining room, sushi bar, kitchen, and storage (PRP-IPM-01).
Zero evidence of German cockroach, housefly, fruit fly (Drosophila), or ant infestation around food prep, sushi rail, or kitchen lines (PRP-IPM-01).
Active contract with licensed Pest Control Operator (PCO); monthly pest service reports and chemical application data sheets filed on-site in LOG-IPM-01.
External building perimeter sealed: Back-of-house entrance doors sealed with magnetic insect screen curtains; kitchen access doors kept closed at all times.
Electronic Insect Light Traps (ILTs) installed away from exposed food lines; glue boards inspected weekly and replaced monthly (PRP-IPM-01).
Absolute Zero-Cardboard policy strictly enforced across wet kitchen, prep, and chiller storage zones (PRP-FAC-01).
Refuse bins foot-pedal operated, plastic-lined, covered with tight-fitting lids, and emptied at every shift closing (PRP-IPM-01).
3-Minute Table Bussing & Two-Step Sanitization: Vacated dining tables cleared, cleaned with detergent, and sanitized with 200 PPM Quat within 3 minutes (SOP-FOH-01).
Servers execute alcohol hand rub immediately post-bussing before touching clean tableware or delivering food plates (SOP-FOH-01).
Front cashier counter 100% free of personal clutter, sneeze guard wiped clear with 70% alcohol, and POS touchscreens sanitized every 2 hours (SOP-FOH-03).
Master Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for 100% of cleaning chemicals and pest control agents archived in an accessible yellow binder on-site (PRP-SAN-01).
Legal Chain of Custody & Traceability: Sourcing exclusively from Central Commissary and FDA/NMIS-accredited suppliers with on-site lot records in LOG-TRACE-01 (PRP-TRACE-01).
